title: 第5章 摸底考试
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
次日早上八点，全年级新生整齐地坐在各自教室里。

    文化课笔试先开始。

    试卷发下来的瞬间，安槐扫了一遍题目，嘴角微微弯了一下。

    物理、数学、武道理论、联邦通识，四科综合，题量不小，两个小时，大部分人写到最后都会手忙脚乱。

    安槐拿起笔，开始答题。

    他上辈子是理科生，知识体系虽然跟这个世界有差异，但底层逻辑是通的。

    数学和物理对他来说跟喝水一样，武道理论他这几个月翻了上百本书，联邦通识更是信手拈来。

    笔尖在试卷上刷刷地走。

    一个小时零十分钟。

    安槐放下笔，检查了一遍，确认无误后翻过试卷，趴在桌上闭目养神。

    苏念念在旁边奋笔疾书，余光瞥到他的动作，手里的笔顿了一下。

    她低头继续写，嘴角抽了抽。

    她已经习惯了。

    从初中开始，每次考试安槐都是第一个交卷，成绩永远第一，他这个人吧，武道天赋高也就算了，文化课还是个变态。

    两小时结束，收卷。

    苏念念放下笔，甩了甩手腕，扭头瞪安槐。

    “你到底是怎么做到的？”

    “什么？”

    “每次考试都像在做小学算术题一样。”

    安槐想了想，认真回答：“可能天生适合考试。”

    苏念念伸手捏了一下他的脸颊，安槐的脸凉凉的，手感很好，她使劲揪了两下才松开。

    “欠揍。”

    安槐摸了摸被捏红的脸，表情无辜。

    【检测到情绪源“苏念念”：嫉妒（15%）、骄傲（50%）、手感真好想再捏一次（35%）。最后一条严格来说不算情绪，但我觉得有必要汇报。】

    安槐面无表情地在心里回了一句。

    “你最近话越来越多了。”

    【谢谢夸奖。】

    上午十点，全年级新生集合在演武场。

    演武场巨大，地面铺着特殊的减震材料，四周设有观战台，十几个教官分列场边，身后各自站着一个班的学生。

    安槐一眼就看到了苏正川。

    苏正川站在教官队列里，国字脸板得跟铁板似的，气场压过了身边好几个同事。

    凝元巅峰的气息不怒自威，几个站在附近的学生腿都在打哆嗦。

    苏念念朝她爸挥了挥手。

    苏正川的面部肌肉颤了一下，那是他在努力让自己别当众露出慈父的表情。
content_en:
At eight o'clock the next morning, all freshmen in the grade sat neatly in their respective classrooms.

The cultural class written test starts first.

The moment the test paper was handed out, An Huai scanned the questions and curved the corners of his mouth slightly.

Physics, mathematics, martial arts theory, and federal general education are all four subjects. The amount of questions is not small. It takes two hours and most people will be in a hurry by the end.

An Huai picked up the pen and started to answer the questions.

He was a science student in his previous life. Although his knowledge system is different from this world, the underlying logic is the same.

Mathematics and physics are like drinking water to him. He has read hundreds of books on martial arts theory in the past few months, and the federal general knowledge is at his fingertips.

The tip of the pen brushed across the test paper.

One hour and ten minutes.

An Huai put down his pen, checked it again, turned over the test paper after confirming that it was correct, and lay on the table with his eyes closed to relax.

Su Niannian was writing furiously beside her. When she caught a glimpse of his movements from the corner of her eye, the pen in her hand paused.

She lowered her head and continued writing, her mouth twitching.

She's used to it.

Since junior high school, An Huai has always been the first to submit papers in every exam, and his grades have always been first. For him, it doesn't matter that he is talented in martial arts, but he is still a pervert in cultural classes.

At the end of two hours, wind up.

Su Niannian put down the pen, flicked her wrist, and turned to glare at An Huai.

"How on earth did you do that?"

"What?"

“Every test is like doing elementary school arithmetic.”

An Huai thought for a while and answered seriously: "Maybe he is born to take the exam."

Su Niannian stretched out her hand and pinched his cheek. An Huai's face felt cool and the touch felt good. She pinched hard twice before letting go.

"Deserves a beating."

An Huai touched his red face with an innocent expression.

[Emotional source "Su Niannian" detected: jealousy (15%), pride (50%), feels so good that I want to pinch it again (35%).The last one is not strictly an emotion, but I feel the need to report it.】

An Huai replied expressionlessly in his mind.

"You've been talking more and more lately."

[Thank you for the compliment.】

At ten o'clock in the morning, all freshmen gathered in the martial arts field.

The martial arts performance field is huge, with special shock-absorbing materials on the ground. There are viewing platforms around it. There are more than a dozen instructors lined up on the side of the field, with students from each class standing behind them.

An Huai saw Su Zhengchuan at a glance.

Su Zhengchuan stood in the queue of instructors, his face as straight as steel, and his aura surpassed that of several colleagues around him.

The peak Ning Yuan's aura was calm and intimidating, and the legs of several students standing nearby were trembling.

Su Niannian waved to her father.

Su Zhengchuan's facial muscles trembled. It was because he was trying not to show his fatherly expression in public.
